messages:
Nora (People Ops): heads-up everyone  we've published a new "Outside Work & Conflict of Interest" policy in the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policies/outside-work. Short summary below.
Nora (People Ops): TL;DR: disclosure required for paid outside work, certain open-source maintainer roles, and any activity that could reasonably conflict with Redwood interests. There's a short disclosure form and a manager-review window of 5 business days.
Ravi (Legal): added: CA-specific notice and consent language. Also added a template for NDAs/consulting exceptions that require Legal sign-off.
Sam (Engineering Manager): question: maintaining OSS repos  is that automatically disallowed? lots of folks contribute in evenings.
Nora (People Ops): OSS contribution is allowed but maintainers of large projects or projects with overlapping customers must disclose. We made a simple threshold in the doc (maintainer of project with >5000+ weekly downloads or a paid product). If disclosed, managers + Legal will assess.
Avery (Recruiting): does this apply to new hires in offer stage? should recruiters include a disclosure step?
Nora (People Ops): yes  recruiters add a boolean in the ATS "outside-work disclosure required" for roles that touch sensitive data. New hires must complete the disclosure within 30 days of start. See ATS template: https://ats.redwood.ai/templates/outside-work.
coi-bot: Action assigned: "Complete Outside Work disclosure" to all employees. Due: 2026-07-10. Link: https://forms.redwood.ai/outside-work-disclosure
Nora (People Ops): managers: please review disclosures within 5 business days and mark approved/mitigated/reject in the review sheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/coi-reviews. Add one-line mitigation plan for anything approved with conditions.
Sam (Engineering Manager): ack  will review eng-team disclosures and add mitigation notes where needed.
Ravi (Legal): retention: disclosure records will be kept for 3 years; any Legal exceptions will be archived in the compliance bucket. Added note in the handbook.
Nora (People Ops): training: lms-bot will assign a 12-min microlearning "Outside Work & COI: what to disclose" to everyone. Managers must also take the manager-review module. Completion required before 2026-07-10.
lms-bot: Assigned course: "Outside Work & COI" to 412 users (all employees). Due: 2026-07-10. Link: https://lms.redwood.ai/courses/outside-work-coi
Avery (Recruiting): ACK  ATS template updated and I'll flag offers that need disclosure. We'll include a note in offer emails.
Nora (People Ops): enforcement note: unreported disallowed outside work may trigger a mitigation plan or disciplinary process per policy. We'll first try to remediate via manager + Legal.
Sam (Engineering Manager): quick ops  any auto-routing for disclosures that hit Legal?
Nora (People Ops): yes  disclosures tagged "sensitive-customer-data" auto-route to Legal+Security. Others route to manager first. If review times exceed 5 business days, tag @Nora and coi-bot will escalate.
coi-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Review outstanding disclosures" will ping managers 2 days before escalation.
Nora (People Ops): action: managers please confirm in the sheet (https://sheets.redwood.ai/coi-reviews) with "ACK" after you've done your first review sweep by end of week. I'll compile a weekly compliance report.
Sam (Engineering Manager): ACK  sweep started for eng-infra.
Avery (Recruiting): ACK  will include disclosure reminder in onboarding checklist.
Nora (People Ops): thanks all  I'll post a short FAQ and the disclosure form link in #docs this afternoon, and coordinate the weekly report with Legal. :white_check_mark:
